name: mcp-doctor
description: Lint the MCP server you're building for what breaks the agent calling it: missing tool descriptions, undocumented parameters, swallowed errors, stdout writes that corrupt stdio, plus a separate security grade. Scans Python, TypeScript and Go source without running it and fixes what it finds; with your OK, launches the server, fuzzes it and gives one SHIP / FIX-FIRST / BLOCK verdict.
